source: Owner 13 Nov 2026: DEOS (Decide, Execute, Operate, Sustain) becomes DOES (Do, Operate, Execute, Sustain) everywhere in HB. Operate moves before Execute: work through HB's tools and records first, then act. Mapping reviewed by Claude Code; applied file by file by APEX with the does_rename tool (plan step S-CFA2CA7023).

manual.core/capability_packs/hummingbird.apex-s: The DEOS definition changes meaning (Decides, Executes, Operates, Sustains -> Do, Operate, Execute, Sustain); edited by hand.
manual.utils/config.py: The DEOS definition changes meaning (Directives, Environment, Operations, Systems -> Do, Operate, Execute, Sustain); edited by hand.

rules_note: Uppercase DEOS occurs in no ordinary word, so it is replaced everywhere (also after \n or _). Lowercase deos only when not preceded by a letter: 'videos' must stay 'videos'.

after_tool.fridays/task_runner.py: After the tool: the cycle description 'decide, execute, operate, sustain' becomes 'do, operate, execute, sustain' (hand edit).

manual_first_note: Seven's chat triggers use the word 'deos'; 'does' is ordinary English. These three lines are patched by hand first; the tool refuses the file until they are gone.
